name: AMI Factory in DEV
title: AMI Factory in DEV
subtitle: Weekly AMI release: build, test, scan, publish · from read-only AWS Config discovery, 10 Nov 2026
alt_text: AMI Factory in the DEV account: a daily EventBridge rule runs CodePipeline and CodeBuild, Image Builder bakes encrypted AMIs from the GovTech parent, test hosts are checked and scanned by Inspector, evidence goes to S3, and a clean release sets SSM pointers and shares AMIs with PROD.

nodes.label:

boot and checks
